content.text:
THE BLUNT REALITY
SAMPLE TEXT, NOT A REAL RUN. The product list moved under our testers' hands on a slow phone. That is ours.

THE DETACHED ASSESSMENT
The skeleton is a short grey block, so the page grows when the cards arrive.

THE RECALIBRATION PLAN
1. Size the skeleton like the card.
2. Give every image its size.
3. Add a throttled CLS check to CI.

THE MARCHING ORDERS
Fix the skeleton today. Measure before and after.
